en: Itivuttaka 70:
Tikanipāta, Tatiyavagga (The Third Chapter)
The Discourse on Those of Wrong View.
This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant; thus have I heard:

"Bhikkhus, I have seen beings who were possessed of misconduct of body, possessed of misconduct of speech, possessed of misconduct of mind, revilers of the noble ones, holding wrong views, and undertaking actions based on wrong views."
With the breakup of the body, after death, they have reappeared in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a lower realm, even in hell.
But this, monks, I do not say having heard it from another ascetic or brahmin;

rather, monks, I have seen for myself beings endowed with bodily misconduct, endowed with verbal misconduct, endowed with mental misconduct, revilers of the noble ones, holding wrong views, and undertaking actions based on wrong views.
With the breakup of the body, after death, they have reappeared in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a lower realm, even in hell.
Moreover, monks, I speak only of that which is personally known, personally seen, and personally realized by me.

Monks, I have seen beings endowed with misconduct of body, endowed with misconduct of speech, endowed with misconduct of mind; revilers of the noble ones, holding wrong views, and undertaking actions based on wrong views.
"With the breakup of the body, after death, they have been reborn in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a lower realm, even in hell.
Thus the Blessed One spoke. With reference to this, it is said:
“Having directed the mind wrongly,
having spoken wrong speech,
and having performed wrong deeds, [one goes to hell].”
In this world, a person who is of little learning and does not perform meritorious deeds,
while their life here is short;
"With the breakup of the body, the one of poor wisdom is reborn in hell.
This matter was also spoken by the Blessed One; thus have I heard.
The first.
